title: Employment Visas and Dependant Passes Issued to Nationals from Countries That Have Signed Free Trade Agreements with Singapore
what_it_is: Employment Visas and Dependant Passes Issued to Nationals from Countries That Have Signed Free Trade Agreements with Singapore

sections.label: Foreign pass holders in small firms
sections.summary: Questions ask how many China, India, USA and Australia nationals on Employment or S Passes work in companies with fewer than 10 employees, and yearly dependant and Long Term Visit Passes issued to their relatives from 2005 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower how many nationals from China, India, USA and Australia holding Employment Passes or S Passes are currently working in companies with fewer than 10 employees.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower for each year from 2005 to 2020, how many (i) dependant passes and (ii) Long Term Visit Passes have been issued to relatives of nationals from China, India, USA and Australia who are Employment Pass or S Pass holders respectively.
